requirements.description: The system shall support community users' registration, login, logout, password recovery, and password changes, persist login-state data, and support administrator login and logout.
The system shall store user profiles, support viewing one's own and other users' homepages, and allow users to change their avatars and usernames.
The system shall store personal browsing history and allow users to query and view their own browsing history.
The system shall distinguish ordinary users from administrators and verify administrator identity during administrator login.
The system shall support administrator user management, including viewing user lists, banning violating users, and restoring banned accounts.
The system shall support administrator content management, including viewing and reviewing posts, managing comments and replies, and handling user reports and feedback.

The system shall support community content and post retrieval and lifecycle management, including searches by topic, user, and post content, as well as post publication, editing, deletion, detail viewing, review-status queries, and homepage recommendations.
The system shall support user-post interactions, including favoriting posts, viewing and removing favorites, commenting, replying to comments, and deleting users' own comments or replies.

The system shall support notification management and notification settings, including generating unread notifications for comments, replies, or post reviews, marking notifications as read, deleting notifications, and storing users' notification preferences.

The system shall support game-save management, including creating, viewing, deleting, continuing, and sharing saves; prioritize cloud saves with local temporary-save fallback when unavailable; and verify save integrity.

The system shall support an AI-driven text-adventure game flow in which players set background information and advance the plot through choices, while generated content and game state remain consistent with that background.

The system shall provide reliability and fault-recovery capabilities, including controlling unexpected-exception frequency, detecting and performing basic fault repair, maintaining service continuity during network or server failures, and providing fault tolerance.

The system shall protect sensitive data and privileged operations by encrypting sensitive data in transit and at rest, restricting sensitive functions to authorized administrators, managing vulnerabilities regularly, and logging and monitoring sensitive operations and system events.

The system shall provide responsive runtime performance for core interactions, including timely login, logout, and game entry or exit, support concurrent users, control service resource usage, and provide timely client feedback.
The system shall run compatibly across different client device types and operating-system versions and adapt to different resolutions and screen sizes.
The system shall use a modular, loosely coupled implementation that is easy to maintain and extend, and shall support automated testing.

components.name: Adaptive Client Application
components.description: Multiplatform user interface providing adaptive layouts for multiple screen sizes and devices, with local storage fallback for saves.

components.name: API Gateway & Traffic Controller
components.description: Entry point handling routing, TLS encryption, rate limiting, request validation, and load balancing.

components.name: Authentication & Session Manager
components.description: Manages user registrations, credentials, password recovery, session state persistence, and role identification.

components.name: User Profile & Browsing History Service
components.description: Stores and manages user profile data, avatars, user homepages, and personal browsing history records.

components.name: Administration & Moderation Service
components.description: Provides administration capabilities including user status management, content moderation, reports, and feedback handling.

components.name: Community Content & Discovery Service
components.description: Handles lifecycle of community posts, topic tagging, content querying/search, and homepage recommendations.

components.name: Social Interaction Service
components.description: Manages user favorites, comments, and replies on community posts.

components.name: Notification & Preferences Service
components.description: Dispatches and tracks read/unread notifications and stores user delivery preferences.

components.name: Save Management & Synchronization Service
components.description: Handles cloud game saves, integrity verification, save sharing, and coordination with client-side fallback storage.

components.name: AI Text Adventure Engine
components.description: Executes game narrative generation, background consistency validation, and choice-driven plot progression.

components.name: Security & Audit Logging Service
components.description: Performs encryption key management, audit logging of privileged operations, access monitoring, and vulnerability monitoring.

components.name: Reliability & Fault Recovery Monitor
components.description: Performs health detection, automated circuit-breaking, error containment, and failure recovery tasks.

components.name: Automated Testing & Modular Test Harness
components.description: Framework providing automated unit, integration, and regression test suites across system modules.

connectors.description: Transmits encrypted API requests and interactive UI commands over HTTPS/WSS.
Routes registration, login, token validation, and password operations.
Forwards profile management and browsing history queries.
Routes administrative actions, user banning, and content reviews.
Directs post search, recommendations, creation, and lifecycle operations.
Transfers commenting, replying, and favoriting actions.
Delivers notification reads, deletions, and user preference updates.
Transfers game save uploads, downloads, integrity checks, and sharing.
Routes narrative generation prompts, player choices, and game progression.
Sends privileged login events, role verifications, and auth failures for auditing.
Logs administrative bans, content reviews, and privileged operations.
Queries user profiles and enforces account restriction states.
Enforces moderation decisions on posts, comments, and reported items.
Triggers unread notification generation for post comments and replies.
Associates community posts with corresponding interaction threads and favorites.
Supplies persistent story states and background context to resume adventure gameplay.
Monitors service health, circuit states, and triggers fallback routes upon failure.
Injects automated test payloads to validate modular interfaces and contracts.
